entities.text: Kondamena Soujanya, vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is stated that the petitioner is the pattadar and possessor of the land admeasuring Acs.4.39 guntas in Sy.No.618/7, situated at Sudimalla Village, Yellandu Mandal, Bhadradri-Kothagudem District and she was also issued pattadar pass book and title deed bearing No.69181 vide Patta No.1073 under the provisions of the Telangana Rights in Land and Pattadar Passbooks Act, 1971 and the Rules made thereunder.

The grievance of the petitioner is that the respondent authorities, without issuing any notice and without following the procedure as contemplated under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency and Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short "the RR Act, 2013"), are making efforts to dispossess her from the subject land.
2. Considered the submissions of the learned counsel for the respective parties and with their consent this writ petition is being disposed of at the admission stage.
CVBR, J Wp_6938_2025 3.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency and Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner relying upon the A-1 notice vide proceedings Rc.No.B/1488/2024, dated 07.12.2024 has vehemently contended that initially the respondent authorities have identified the land admeasuring Acs.20.00 guntas in Sy.No.618 claiming that the same is a Government land and directed the petitioner to submit her explanation to the said notice.

Learned counsel further contended that even if the land is Government land and since the petitioner is in possession of the same and pattadar passbook has been issued in her favour, she has to treat as rightful owner for payment of compensation under the provisions of the RR Act, 2013 as per the guidelines issued by this Court in LAO-cum-RDO, Chevella Division, Domalaguda, Hyderabad v.
Mekala Pandu 1.
4. Sri L.Ravinder, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue appearing for the respondents has submitted that initially the Government land situated in Sy.No.618, situated at Sudimalla Village, was identified for construction of Integrated Residential School Complex for SC, ST, BC and Minorities and now the land in Sy.No.549 of Rompaid Village is identified for the construction of the said school.
Therefore, the land claimed 2004(2) ALD 451 CVBR, J Wp_6938_2025 by the petitioner and the land identified for construction of the school is totally different and distinct.

5. In view of the above submissions and since it is the case of the petitioner that the respondents are making efforts to dispossess her from the lands in Sy.No.618 and its sub-division numbers of Sudimalla Village whereas the learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue relying upon the Kondamena Soujanya, vs The State Of Telangana, on 7 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/69439838/
1 instructions has submitted that the proposed construction of the said School building is in Sy.No.549 of Rompaid village, this Court is of the opinion that the ends of justice would be met if the Inspector of Survey at R.D.O. Officer is directed to conduct survey for fixation of the boundaries and localisation of the lands in both the survey numbers after issuing notice the neighbouring pattadars of both the survey numbers and after conducting survey if the land is identified in Sy.No.618 as claimed by the petitioner

entities.text: Kondamena Soujanya, vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: , the respondents are directed to follow the procedure prescribed as contemplated under RR Act, 2013 and also the guidelines issued in Mekala Pandu's case.
If the lands are not forming part of Sy.No.618, the respondent authorities are at liberty to proceed with the construction of the school building strictly in accordance with law.
The above exercise shall be CVBR, J Wp_6938_2025 completed within a period of four (04) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
Till such time, the respondent authorities are directed not to take any coercive steps over the subject land.
6. With the above observations, this Writ Petition is disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
7. As a sequel, the miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.
